Name: Fippsie's Yami Yugi Hair (For Fashion Sense)
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]This mod lets you use Yami Yugi's Hairstyle. :)

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=description]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿.
3. Download the mod anywhere and then unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.



[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]

[b]When creating a new character:[/b]
Make sure your Hair Color settings are like this so that it looks correct! :)

[img]https://abload.de/img/hair4tjgn.jpg[/img]

[b]
[/b][b]When using an existing character:[/b]
Buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url]﻿ from Pierre for 1500 coins.﻿[/center]
